name.baseName: Monocoque wooden school chair, at production

dataSetInformation.common:synonyms: Seduta monoscocca curvata in legno, alla produzione
dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Dataset developed within the ARCADIA Project (production chain study regarding wooden monocoque school chair: "STUDIO DI FILIERA DELLA SEDUTA MONOSCOCCA CURVATA”), in compliance with the technical report “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA”. The dataset refers to the production of a wooden monocoque school chair and is representative of the average Italian processing technologies commonly used for the production of wooden monocoque school chair.

referenceToExternalDocumentation.common:shortDescription: Fantin V., Frisone F., Rinaldi C., Cecchini A., 2023. STUDIO DI FILIERA DELLA SEDUTA MONOSCOCCA CURVATA. Internal report ARCADIA Project. Background datasets from Ecoinvent database cut-off (v.3.7.1) were used for the LCA study.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Italy. Primary data collected in Veneto. Dataset representative of Italian production of monocoque wooden school chairs

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: The functional unit is 1 p (= 1unit) of wooden monocoque school chair; the total weight of the school chair is 4,632 kg (its dimensions are 40 cm*40 cm*46 cm (height)). The production process begins with the arrival of raw steel frames and monocoque seats at the manufacturing company. Then the steel frames are painted, pre-treated, dried in the oven, painted and polymerised. The iron steel and the monocoque are finally assembled. No final packaging is used. Production of equipment and infrastructure is not included, with the exception of the background system. Primary (Veneto supply chain) data representative of the Italian supply chain by geographical characteristics and technologies used (machinery, equipment, etc.) were collected. Inventory data were collected as physical quantities of materials used in the different processes. The benefits from the production and use of energy from incineration and landfills have been excluded, as well as those deriving from the use of secondary materials produced from the recycling of waste materials (eg plastic and cardboard).
technology.technologicalApplicability: The product is used in schools, especially in classrooms for primary and secondary schools as well as common areas such as libraries, study rooms, teachers' rooms, etc.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.dataCutOffAndCompletenessPrinciples: Production of equipment and infrastructure are not included, except for the background system.

review.common:reviewDetails: The review was performed in compliance with Arcadia Methodology “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA”. The dataset has been assessed limited to the foreground data collected during the supply chain studies. Each dataset has been evaluated on the basis of the following 4 criteria: 1. Temporal Representativeness 2. Geographic Representativeness 3. Technological Representativeness 4. Reliability (A). In this context the Reliability is good.
review.common:otherReviewDetails: The study was judged by the reviewer as compliant with both ISO 14040-44 and Arcadia methodology..
